parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: WAF operation phase, used to filter template rules for a specific phase.

parameters.name: QueryArgs
parameters.description: Query parameters, used to filter template rules based on conditions such as rule type.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-waf-template-rules --site-id 1 --instance-id esa-site-aud6ftk57ym8 --phase http_anti_scan --query-args http_anti_scan --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListWafTemplateRules --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --Phase http_anti_scan --QueryArgs http_anti_scan --InstanceId 'esa-site-aud6ftk57ym8'
